text:
sara (AE): Hey team — ACME POC kickoff: they want Dedicated pool + SSO + SCIM. They can log into IdP but SAML assertion fails when we hit dedicated control plane. Error from their side: 'Assertion not yet valid' and 'Invalid NameID format'. Can we triage? Need short-term hosted API key to run smoke tests while we fix SAML.

mike (SE): Can you paste the raw SAML response? Also which dedicated region? usually clock skew or NameID format.

sara (AE): region: us-west-2-dedicated-1. Attached SAML snippet from customer (redacted):

<saml:Assertion Issuer="https://idp.acme.com" IssueInstant="2025-08-12T18:24:56Z">...

sara (AE): They use NameID format 'unspecified' and their time skew is +3m.

mike (SE): Two quick things — our SAML acceptance window default is +-60s. Ask IdP to set notBefore/notOnOrAfter correctly or we can relax window for this tenant temporarily. NameID should be emailAddress usually. Example mapping:

```yaml
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
AttributeMapping:
  email: user.email
  displayName: user.displayName
```

mike (SE): If you want quick smoke tests, I can issue a hosted API key scoped to ACME for 2 days. Will that unblock demos?

sara (AE): Yes please. They also report SCIM provisioning creating duplicate users and 404s when we point to dedicated SCIM endpoint.

olivia (support): grabbing SCIM logs: got 404s like `GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=email%20eq%20%22jdoe%40acme.com%22` -> 404 and `POST /scim/v2/Users` -> 500 TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate.

javier (eng-infra): Dedicated private control plane requires customer to allow our SCIM egress IPs or peer their VPC. Looks like their firewall dropped requests. Also 500 TLS bad cert could mean they terminate TLS on their side — we expect mutual TLS only for Private. Do they have mTLS? If yes, we need their cert.

sara (AE): They said no mTLS. They think it's our cert mismatch after metadata rotation.

mike (SE): Two paths: 1) For immediate unblock we give hosted API key + hosted SCIM test user flow. 2) For long-term, ask ACME infra to add our egress CIDR 34.200.64.0/22 and confirm TLS cert chain. I'll draft the email and the exact CIDR.

mike (SE): FYI I'll relax SAML window for tenant for 48h and issue temporary hosted key if security approves.

idp-bot: audit: SAML relaxation requested by mike (SE) for tenant acme-corp — expires in 48h.

olivia (support): Security approved temporary hosted key with scope: read:models, invoke:dedicated (no admin). Sending key via 1:1 secure channel.

sara (AE): Thanks all — I'll coordinate with ACME infra and confirm when they add CIDR and swap NameID. Will report back here. :thumbsup:

mike (SE): If they hit duplicates on SCIM, ask them to include externalId in payload and set `schemas` properly. Example create payload snippet:

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "externalId": "acme-jdoe",
  "userName": "jdoe@acme.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}
}
```

sara (AE): Noted. Closing loop after ACME confirms. Thanks! :pray:
